text: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality and Identity • Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport, of good character and sound health • Those who are originally citizens of China must comply with the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education (Letter No.12 [2020]) 2. Educational Requirements • Possess an educational background equivalent to Chinese high school graduation. 3. Academic Transcript • Must provide official high school transcripts, graduation certificate (or pre-graduation certificate) • Provide scores from national/international standardized tests (e.g., SAT, A-Level, IB) 4. Language Requirements • Non-native Chinese speakers must provide a valid HSK Level 4 certificate (score ≥180) or above 5. Age Requirement • Must be at least 18 years old by September 1, 2026 • Applicants under 18 must submit notarized guardian documents as required
